articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
articles.snippet: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.

articles.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
articles.snippet: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

articles.title: PHP Panic: Two Critical Bugs Put 70% of the Internet at Risk, and Everyone Is Freaking Out
articles.snippet: Two critical bugs in PHP, the language running most of the web, let strangers take over servers without a password. The patch is out, attacks started early, and governments pulled the plug.
